source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 6 June 1952, p. 5 ("County and rural council elections: results"); Belfast News-Letter, 21 May 1952, p. 10 ("County and rural council nominations"); Irish News, 6 June 1952, p. 3 ("Coleraine Rural District results")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: BNL 6 Jun 1952 p5 results, read in the block image (BNL19520606.2.129 area 4): Williamson 303, Adams 56; INW 6 Jun 1952 p3 prints the same figures with majority 247. No party labels printed in the results or nominations.

note: Triennial election of the 21 electoral divisions of Coleraine rural district, one member each, polled on 5 June 1952. Nineteen retiring members were returned unopposed; Garvagh and Articlave were contested and both sitting members held their seats. The Rev. J. C. Williamson, B.A., the outgoing member, defeated Lieut.-Colonel Thomas Adams. Adams's vote is 56 (image and Irish News; majority 247); the record had 66. No party label was printed.
